using namespace std;

class FastScanner {
private:
    istream& in;
    vector<char> buffer;
    int ptr, buflen;
    
public:
    FastScanner(istream& is = cin) : in(is), buffer(1024), ptr(0), buflen(0) {}
    
    bool hasNextByte() {
        if (ptr < buflen) return true;
        ptr = 0;
        try {
            in.read(buffer.data(), buffer.size());
            buflen = in.gcount();
        } catch (...) {
            // Handle exception silently
        }
        return buflen > 0;
    }
    
    char readByte() {
        return hasNextByte() ? buffer[ptr++] : -1;
    }
    
    static bool isPrintableChar(char c) {
        return c > 32 || c < 0;
    }
    
    static bool isNumber(char c) {
        return c >= '0' && c <= '9';
    }
    
    bool hasNext() {
        while (hasNextByte() && !isPrintableChar(buffer[ptr])) ptr++;
        return hasNextByte();
    }
    
    string next() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw runtime_error("No more elements");
        string sb;
        char b;
        while (isPrintableChar(b = readByte())) sb += b;
        return sb;
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw runtime_error("No more elements");
        long long n = 0;
        char b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            while(isNumber(b = readByte())) n = n * 10 + '0' - b;
            return n;
        } else if (!isNumber(b)) {
            throw runtime_error("Number format error");
        }
        do n = n * 10 + b - '0'; while (isNumber(b = readByte()));
        return n;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw runtime_error("No more elements");
        int n = 0;
        char b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            while(isNumber(b = readByte())) n = n * 10 + '0' - b;
            return n;
        } else if (!isNumber(b)) {
            throw runtime_error("Number format error");
        }
        do n = n * 10 + b - '0'; while (isNumber(b = readByte()));
        return n;
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
};

class IntMath {
public:
    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        while (a != 0) {
            if ((b %= a) != 0) a %= b;
            else return a;
        }
        return b;
    }
    
    static int gcd(const vector<int>& array) {
        int ret = array[0];
        for (size_t i = 1; i < array.size(); ++i) ret = gcd(ret, array[i]);
        return ret;
    }
    
    static long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
        while (a != 0) {
            if ((b %= a) != 0) a %= b;
            else return a;
        }
        return b;
    }
    
    static long long gcd(const vector<long long>& array) {
        long long ret = array[0];
        for (size_t i = 1; i < array.size(); ++i) ret = gcd(ret, array[i]);
        return ret;
    }
    
    static long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }
    
    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        for (int mul = a; b > 0; b >>= 1, mul *= mul) 
            if ((b & 1) != 0) ans *= mul;
        return ans;
    }
    
    static int pow(int a, int b, int mod) {
        if (b < 0) b = b % (mod - 1) + mod - 1;
        long long ans = 1;
        for (long long mul = a; b > 0; b >>= 1, mul = mul * mul % mod) 
            if ((b & 1) != 0) ans = ans * mul % mod;
        return (int)ans;
    }
    
    static int floorsqrt(long long n) {
        return (int)sqrt(n + 0.1);
    }
    
    static int ceilsqrt(long long n) {
        return n <= 1 ? (int)n : (int)sqrt(n - 0.1) + 1;
    }
};

void sortInt(vector<int>& array) {
    int l, min_val = 0xFFFFFFFF, max_val = 0;
    for (l = 0; l < array.size(); ++l) {
        int i = array[l];
        min_val &= i;
        max_val |= i;
        if ((i & 0x80000000) == 0) break;
    }
    for (int r = l + 1; r < array.size(); ++r) {
        int i = array[r];
        min_val &= i;
        max_val |= i;
        if ((i & 0x80000000) != 0) {
            array[r] = array[l];
            array[l++] = i;
        }
    }
    int use = min_val ^ max_val, bit = (int)highestOneBit(use & 0x7FFFFFFF);
    if (bit == 0) return;
    sort(array, 0, l, use, bit);
    sort(array, l, array.size(), use, bit);
}

void sort(vector<int>& array, int left, int right, int use, int digit) {
    if (right - left <= 96) {
        for (int i = left + 1; i < right; ++i) {
            int tmp = array[i], tmp2, j;
            for (j = i; j > left && (tmp2 = array[j - 1]) > tmp; --j) array[j] = tmp2;
            array[j] = tmp;
        }
        return;
    }
    int l = left;
    while(l < right && (array[l] & digit) == 0) ++l;
    for (int r = l + 1; r < right; ++r) {
        int i = array[r];
        if ((i & digit) == 0) {
            array[r] = array[l];
            array[l++] = i;
        }
    }
    if ((digit = (int)highestOneBit(use & digit - 1)) == 0) return;
    sort(array, left, l, use, digit);
    sort(array, l, right, use, digit);
}

long long highestOneBit(long long i) {
    if (i == 0) return 0;
    i |= (i >> 1);
    i |= (i >> 2);
    i |= (i >> 4);
    i |= (i >> 8);
    i |= (i >> 16);
    i |= (i >> 32);
    return i - (i >> 1);
}

void sortLong(vector<long long>& array) {
    int l;
    long long min_val = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFLL, max_val = 0;
    for (l = 0; l < array.size(); ++l) {
        long long i = array[l];
        min_val &= i;
        max_val |= i;
        if ((i & 0x8000000000000000LL) == 0) break;
    }
    for (int r = l + 1; r < array.size(); ++r) {
        long long i = array[r];
        min_val &= i;
        max_val |= i;
        if ((i & 0x8000000000000000LL) != 0) {
            array[r] = array[l];
            array[l++] = i;
        }
    }
    long long use = min_val ^ max_val, bit = highestOneBit(use & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFLL);
    if (bit == 0) return;
    sort(array, 0, l, use, bit);
    sort(array, l, array.size(), use, bit);
}

void sort(vector<long long>& array, int left, int right, long long use, long long digit) {
    if (right - left <= 96) {
        for (int i = left + 1; i < right; ++i) {
            long long tmp = array[i], tmp2;
            for (int j = i; j > left && (tmp2 = array[j - 1]) > tmp; --j) array[j] = tmp2;
            array[j] = tmp;
        }
        return;
    }
    int l = left;
    while(l < right && (array[l] & digit) == 0) ++l;
    for (int r = l + 1; r < right; ++r) {
        long long i = array[r];
        if ((i & digit) == 0) {
            array[r] = array[l];
            array[l++] = i;
        }
    }
    if ((digit = highestOneBit(use & digit - 1)) == 0) return;
    sort(array, left, l, use, digit);
    sort(array, l, right, use, digit);
}

void solve(FastScanner& fs, ostream& out) {
    int n = fs.nextInt();
    long long k = fs.nextLong();
    vector<long long> fact(n + 1), inv(n + 1);
    const int MOD = 998244353;
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    inv[n] = IntMath::pow((int)fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;
    
    auto comb = [&](int i, int j) -> long long {
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD;
    };
    
    if (k == 0) {
        out << fact[n] << endl;
    } else if (k > n) {
        out << 0 << endl;
    } else {
        int k2 = (int)k, k3 = n - k2;
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k3; ++i) {
            long long tmp = comb(k3, i) * IntMath::pow(i, n, MOD) % MOD;
            if ((k3 - i & 1) != 0) {
                ans -= tmp;
            } else {
                ans += tmp;
            }
        }
        ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
        out << ans << endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    ostream out(cout.rdbuf());
    solve(fs, out);
    out.flush();
    return 0;
}
